project.name: web (usehako.site)
project.productType: Hako: a box of paid tools and LI.FI money moves for AI agents, paid and signed with the user's PayBox wallet, shown as cards in the web app and inside AI hosts

direction.name: Senryo · Hako
direction.summary: Kawase's Senryo exactly (tamion/DESIGN.md): light-first neutrals (#F5F5F5 ground, white cards, #ECECEC insets), black primary actions, one accent with black labels only for selected controls, the focus ring and badges, up/down only for direction, Inter for the interface and Roboto Condensed Black for money and titles, tabular figures. Hako's accent is asagi (浅葱) #009CA8 instead of Kawase's magenta.

authority.designSystem: tamion/DESIGN.md (Senryo) with packages/brand/tokens.json for Hako's values

installed.name: Rail (Sidebar 001)
installed.install: shadcn CLI 4.21.4 with the 21st registry item (`21st add` resolves to the same command)
installed.deviations: The published file is 552 lines; its contexts, scroll hook and hover highlight moved unchanged to sidebar-001-utils/context.tsx, and its separator, header and footer to sidebar-001-utils/parts.tsx (re-exported from sidebar-001.tsx under the same names), so every file stays under the repo's 400-line limit. Its --accent-pro indicator colour points at the Hako accent in packages/ui/src/styles.css (the active row: the moment that matters). Its hover highlight `bg-accent/50` (shadcn's `accent` is a hover surface) is Senryo's pressed row `bg-row-pressed`: Hako's `accent` is the hue, so the author's class would paint every hovered row asagi.

decisions.decision: Hako's accent is asagi #009CA8 with black labels, chosen against the contrast check; every other value is Senryo's
Token names keep Kawase's (shadcn's variables plus Senryo's), so Kawase code ports without renames; `accent` is the hue, as in Kawase
One icon set (lucide) and one `cn` (the `cn` package via @hako/ui/lib/utils): installed files that bundled tabler icons or their own clsx + tailwind-merge helper were pointed at them
Demo bodies of 21st items (c-stepper-15's sample steps, empty-states-4's sample toasts) are not kept; their primitives are

shadcn's `accent` is a hover surface; Hako's `accent` is the hue (one accent only for the moment that matters). Installed files that use `bg-accent` as a surface point at Senryo's quiet surfaces instead: `bg-row-pressed` for hover (Sidebar 001's highlight), `bg-muted` for pending (the stepper's indicator). `rg 'bg-accent|text-accent-foreground' packages/ui apps` finds no other use

@hako/ui imports the radix-nova style base `shadcn/tailwind.css` (shadcn 4.21.4 as its devDependency, the CLI version that did the installs): the data-open/closed/checked/active/horizontal/vertical variants on Radix's data-state and data-orientation, the accordion keyframes, and the shimmer, scroll-fade and no-scrollbar utilities the installed components use

rules: 21st.dev and shadcn first for every visible component; every installed file is listed here with its source.
Installed code keeps its author's style; colours always resolve to @hako/brand tokens (no hex outside packages/brand).
Real marks from @hako/identity for every chain, token, provider and route; the labelled neutral disc when none is delivered, never a stand-in.
Every surface draws loading (shaped skeleton, held 300 ms), empty (why + next action), error (what still works + one fix) and offline states.
